title: XML and model metadata
current_gap: Vendor XML observations exist, but no owned versioned parser binds ModelInfo/HoverInfo/FrameInfo/ClassID, defaults, units and errors to an asset and model identity.

atoms.name: ModelInfo
atoms.required: Parsed typed fields, units, defaults, source/hash and model identity

atoms.name: HoverInfo
atoms.required: Field semantics, reference condition, units and ranges

atoms.name: FrameInfo
atoms.required: Rotor/arm order, geometry, signs, mixer and stack binding

atoms.name: ClassID
atoms.required: Explicit namespace-to-asset manifest binding and mismatch rejection

atoms.name: defaults_units_errors
atoms.required: Versioned required fields, conversions, defaults and distinct error codes

record_contract.source_rule: explicit path and SHA-256; source remains read-only
record_contract.accepted_means: parsed, normalized and stored metadata only
record_contract.class_id_rule: ClassID=-1 is not an asset binding

followups.blocked_by: Asset ownership and ClassID namespace decision
